Records one Wiki view each time an article is shown: on a direct load, a link, Back, Forward and a reload, and never on a prefetch or a refresh. No event covers all of those arrivals; recording it in the server render would make a page read write, lose views served from the router's cache on Back and count refreshes.

apps/web/src/features/wiki/ArticleSessio.reason: Temporary, waiting for a shared scroll-progress observer in packages/ui. Measures how far the article has been read; when the article has no scroll column of its own the page scrolls, so the listener is on the window. Attached from the column's own ref and removed when it detaches.
